text: I feel a sense of curiosity and wonder here. The sleek, modern glass walls and the abundance of backpacks suggest a space of learning or collaboration. Moving closer, the colorful exhibit labeled "R+D" excites me intellectually; it evokes thoughts on the fusion of research and creativity. Each detail, from the digital displays to the bold wall art, invites reflection on how spaces shape our understanding of knowledge and innovation. I feel as though I’m on the threshold of discovery, where ideas are both assembled and exhibited in public view.
